## Daily Macro Digest — 24 August 2026

**Summary:** The standout move today is gold, which jumped 3.64% to $4,680/oz — a statistically large move (z-score 2.34) with no clear headline catalyst in today's feed (most news sources returned errors, and the oil-sector items that did come through are unrelated to precious metals). Everything else was comparatively quiet: silver rose a more modest 2.21%, oil was little changed (WTI -0.88%, Brent +0.65%), the US dollar index dipped slightly (-0.1%), the US 10-year yield ticked up 0.89%, and the VIX (a measure of expected market volatility) fell 5.5%, suggesting broad risk appetite rather than fear. AUD/USD rose 0.67% and ASX materials stocks were essentially flat (-0.13%), showing no strong pass-through from gold's surge into local mining equities.

**Flagged asset: Gold (+3.64%, anomaly)**
